# herdr-toolkit

> Claude Code plugin with two operating skills for running Claude Code on top of Herdr, the terminal agent multiplexer: spawning detached Remote Control sessions into Herdr panes (spawn-session), and sending prompts to agents in Herdr panes with landing confirmation and a completion wait (agent-send).

## Core documentation

- [Full AI Reference](llms-full.txt): self-contained facts, Q&A, and failure-mode catalog for this plugin
- [README](README.md): human-facing narrative (English)
- [README 日本語](README.ja.md): human-facing narrative (Japanese)
- [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md): release history

## Skills

- [spawn-session](skills/spawn-session/SKILL.md): start a named, detached Claude Code Remote Control session for any project directory in its own Herdr pane, with optional model, effort, permission mode and first prompt; includes spawn.sh
- [agent-send](skills/agent-send/SKILL.md): send a prompt to an agent in a Herdr pane and report whether it landed, or wait until the work is done; includes agent-send.sh

## Plugin manifests

- [plugin.json](.claude-plugin/plugin.json): Claude Code plugin manifest (v2.1.1, MIT)
- [marketplace.json](.claude-plugin/marketplace.json): self-owned marketplace pointing at this repo

## Related

- [Herdr](https://github.com/herdrdev/herdr): the upstream terminal agent multiplexer (Apache-2.0, by ogulcancelik); prints its own herdr CLI skill with `herdr --skill`
- [claude-harness](https://github.com/shimo4228/claude-harness): the author's aggregate harness export, where these skills also appear
- [akc-cycle](https://github.com/shimo4228/akc-cycle): the author's Claude Code plugin that installs the Agent Knowledge Cycle (audit and upkeep skills plus an optional rules file)
- [harness-scope](https://github.com/shimo4228/harness-scope): the author's Claude Code Mod that turns global skills, agents, rules and tools on or off per repo with named profiles
- [shimo4228](https://github.com/shimo4228/shimo4228): the author's hub, with the long-running practice lines and their DOIs
